name: Server Health Check
description: End-to-end vitals sweep on a single host: reachability, disk pressure, memory pressure, CPU load, and a sample service. Emits a single bash echo summary so the run output is operator-readable in one paragraph.

steps.description: Disk usage on the target host

steps.command: ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=5 ${inputs.host} 'systemctl is-active ${inputs.service} && systemctl status ${inputs.service} --no-pager -l | head -20'

steps.description: Compose a one-paragraph summary referencing each prior step
steps.command: echo 'Health check on ${inputs.host}: ping=${steps.ping.ok}, disk=${steps.disk.ok}, memory=${steps.memory.ok}, cpu=${steps.cpu.ok}, service[${inputs.service}]=${steps.service.ok}'
